description: Source code for the BuilderRecord class, which manages build dependency records, including dependency addition, resolution, and classification within a build system.

classes.name: BuilderRecord
classes.description: Represents a build dependency record, managing dependencies, resolution status, and dependency types within a build graph.

methods.name: GetNameForType
methods.description: Returns a string name corresponding to an ItemType enum value.

methods.name: IsItemOfType
methods.description: Checks if a given Item matches a specified ItemType.

methods.name: TypeOfItem
methods.description: Determines the ItemType of a given Item.

methods.name: AddDep
methods.description: Adds a dependency record and updates unresolved counts if necessary.

methods.name: AddGenDep
methods.description: Adds a generated dependency without waiting for resolution.

methods.name: AddValidationDep
methods.description: Adds a validation dependency, affecting resolution and writing constraints.

methods.name: OnDefinedDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a dependency is defined, updating unresolved counts.

methods.name: OnResolvedDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a dependency is resolved, updating unresolved counts.

methods.name: OnResolvedValidationDep
methods.description: Handles the event when a validation dependency is resolved.

methods.name: GetSortedUnresolvedDeps
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unresolved dependencies related to this record.
